news.title: Goa: Development in eco fragile land, tenants issue spark Mandur gram sabha
news.para: During the recent Azossim-Mandur gram sabha meeting, attendees addressed the proposed large-scale project on Azossim hill and its potential environmental consequences. Discussions also included tenant management and issues surrounding littering in rental properties. A controversial new road route through a verdant forest was debated, alongside occupancy certificates issued previously. The sarpanch committed to tackling the deteriorating Pilar-Old Goa road and the necessary BMC reconstitution.

news.title: Delhi development body to hold over 20 meetings in three months over MPD 2047
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority is gearing up for more than twenty stakeholder meetings in the near future. These critical dialogues will hone in on executing the Master Plan for Delhi 2047, welcoming contributions from elected officials, governmental organizations, industry representatives, and local residents alike. Furthermore, updates to the Delhi Development Act are set to support the swift rollout of the land pooling policy.

news.title: Smartworks adds ₹235 crore contracted rental revenue from client expansions
news.para: Smartworks has added about ₹235 crore of incremental contracted rental revenue through expansion mandates from existing enterprise clients. The revenue is in addition to the company’s ₹5,400 crore contracted rental revenue base as of June 30, 2026.

news.title: Illegal buildings across Hyderabad rise as tribunal remains elusive
news.para: Hyderabad is currently wrestling with a surge in unauthorized buildings, posing a serious challenge to urban planning. Authorities are still far from establishing a municipal tribunal that could streamline the resolution of these issues. With over a thousand complaints lodged regarding these illegal structures, the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation is on high alert.

news.title: Goa government to amend stamp law for ‘Mhajo Flat’
news.para: Goa plans to introduce a bill to amend stamp duty laws for flat owners.  The Mhajo Flat Scheme aims to reduce burdens on property redevelopment projects.  This initiative will address issues concerning apartment ownership and facilitate urban infrastructure improvements.  It seeks to prevent duplicate stamp duty charges on related development agreements.  The government considers this necessary for safe housing and efficient housing schemes.

news.title: Kajaria Ceramics targets ₹6,000 crore revenue, ₹1,000-1,100 crore EBITDA in FY27: MD
news.para: Kajaria Ceramics expects revenue to grow to about ₹6,000 crore in FY27 and ₹7,000 crore in FY28, supported by tile capacity expansion, price increases, cost optimisation and growth in sanitaryware, faucets and adhesives. The company reported ₹4,832.50 crore revenue, ₹861.95 crore EBITDA and ₹485.41 crore net profit in FY26.

news.title: Raidurg real estate rush drives record earnings for Telangana exchequer
news.para: Hyderabad Knowledge City has emerged as a vital financial asset for Telangana, recently generating over ten thousand crore rupees from land auctions. A standout sale featured an acre of Raidurg land fetching an astounding two hundred sixty-four crore rupees. The burgeoning IT sector has dramatically amplified the value of this prime real estate, while transparent bidding practices are ensuring competitive pricing and maximizing the state's revenue potential.

news.title: Pay 10.8% interest to buyers for flat handover delay: Haryana RERA to Pyramid Infratech
news.para: Haryana RERA has mandated Pyramid Infratech to reimburse homebuyers for their delayed possession of properties. The developer is obliged to pay a 10.8 percent annual interest rate to four individuals involved in the Pyramid Fusion Homes venture. The authority rebuffed the company's claims regarding construction delays, emphasizing that conveyance deeds do not absolve them of their statutory duties for late possessions.

news.title: Gurugram: Eight years on, only 10% work done at OSB Golf Heights, homebuyers protest
news.para: After eight long years, buyers at OSB Golf Heights have taken to protesting against the stalled construction of their homes. Having invested up to 87.5% of the flat costs, they’re dismayed to see merely ten percent completed after nearly three years of inactivity. With escalating EMIs, they are now appealing to government officials for a swift resolution and a definitive plan for project completion.

news.title: Mumbai police's EOW adds more charges in Suraksha ARC case
news.para: Mumbai Police's Economic Offences Wing added cheating and forgery charges against Suraksha ARC. These new charges stem from a petition filed by a former director of Sapphire Land Development. The Enforcement Directorate provided crucial information which led to the EOW's decision. Investigations are ongoing into potential money laundering involving stressed assets and former Yes Bank officials. Previous charges included criminal breach of trust and criminal conspiracy in the case.

news.title: SC gives relief to residents of South Mumbai twin towers, restores construction curbs on builder
news.para: The Supreme Court has restored construction restrictions on The Imperial developer. Bombay High Court must now expedite the developer's pending appeal against these restraints. Residents had challenged revised building plans and additional construction by S D Corporation. The court ruled that the single judge's interim injunction will continue during the appeal. This ensures construction on Towers A and B requires resident consent and Tower C remains capped.

news.title: Gurugram: RWA escalate protest over delayed maintenance handover at BPTP Park Serene, to withhold payments
news.para: Residents of BPTP Park Serene are withholding maintenance payments. They demand the formal handover of services from the builder. Residents allege the builder has delayed the process with conflicting clauses. Disputed charges include management and dewatering fees, totaling Rs 2 crore annually. The builder denies these claims and cites changing RWA requirements.

news.title: Haryana RERA orders three-month civil imprisonment for Ansal Properties' director
news.para: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has mandated civil imprisonment for an Ansal director, Jagat Chandra, who is sentenced to three months behind bars for failing to comply with a court order. His absence from both personal and virtual proceedings raised concerns, with the authority highlighting his prior disregard for compliance and outstanding costs. An arrest warrant will follow upon depositing the necessary subsistence allowance.

news.title: Pride Hotels steps up expansion, plans ₹1,000-crore IPO by December 2026
news.para: Pride Hotels is gearing up for an initial public offering targeted for December, with an ambitious issue size of Rs 1,000 crore. In a bid to broaden its reach, the hospitality chain is on track to grow its portfolio to 72 properties within the next two years, focusing on leveraging high-demand leisure, wedding, and pilgrimage locations.

news.title: Orris Infrastructure's MD Amit Gupta arrested by Mumbai police in cheating case
news.para: Amit Gupta, the managing director of Orris Infrastructure, has been taken into custody by Mumbai Police following a complaint from Godrej Properties Limited. The allegations involve serious charges of forgery, cheating, and criminal conspiracy tied to a collaborative project. Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Gupta stands accused of unlawfully altering records, sparking worries among homebuyers eager for their properties' possession.

news.title: Sales bookings of 28 major listed real estate firms fall 21% to ₹40,000 crore in Apr-Jun 2026
news.para: In the June quarter, India's leading 28 real estate developers experienced a notable slump, with sales bookings plummeting by twenty-one percent to approximately forty thousand crore. The decline can be attributed to reduced volumes and limited project launches. Notably, Godrej Properties reclaimed its position as the top developer by sales bookings, while experts forecast a sales resurgence starting in the second quarter.

news.title: Land monetisation plan around Nagpur airport  gains pace
news.para: The Nagpur airport's land monetisation is set to accelerate, as consultancy firms are called to devise a strategic plan for the expansive 271 hectares. This development will pave the way for diverse commercial, industrial, and residential projects. With a focus on modernising the airport, the initiative aims to significantly enhance passenger capacity and cultivate a vital economic corridor.

news.title: Odisha eyes 30,000 affordable houses under PMAY-Urban 2.0
news.para: Odisha plans to build thousands of affordable and rental homes statewide. Detailed project reports and technical support will come from consultancy firms working on this initiative. Major urban centers such as Bhubaneswar and Cuttack will receive a large portion of these housing developments, which focus on sustainable, climate-resilient designs in accordance with the PMAY-U 2.0 scheme for urban poor and middle-class households.

news.title: Goa: Builder told to pay ₹19.7 lakh maintenance dues on unsold units
news.para: A developer is required to settle maintenance dues amounting to almost twenty lakh rupees for unsold units within a housing complex in Margao. The governing authority has determined that builders are responsible for maintenance costs on all unsold areas. Despite the developer contesting this ruling, their objections were dismissed, and they are obligated to pay both the outstanding balance and ongoing monthly maintenance fees.

news.title: Ageing Delhi colonies to get a chance to rebuild, grow under master plan 2047
news.para: Delhi's Master Plan 2047 outlines a strategy to rejuvenate aging government colonies and housing societies. To initiate redevelopment, a minimum plot size of 3,000 square metres is necessary for any new construction. Residents have the option to combine properties for modernization, leading to improved living conditions and amenities. Additionally, any new road development must gain approval before projects can begin.
